channel.title: SheetlyPro — AI Agent Use Cases
channel.description: Real things people are doing with AI agents, collected every day.

item.title: Claim airline compensation for a delayed flight
item.description: A traveler fed an agent their delayed flight details and the airline's policy page; the agent drafted a compensation claim citing the right regulation and they received a $200 voucher. (Agents: ChatGPT · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Negotiate a rent increase down with comparable listings
item.description: A renter had an agent pull comparable listings in their neighborhood, then draft a counter-offer email when the landlord proposed a 12% increase. They settled at 4%. (Agents: ChatGPT · Source: X)

item.title: Spot errors on an itemized medical bill
item.description: A poster uploaded an itemized hospital bill; the agent spotted a duplicate lab charge and drafted a dispute letter with the exact line items referenced. The charge was removed. (Agents: ChatGPT · Source: Substack)

item.title: Turn scattered notes into a conference talk outline
item.description: A speaker dumped scattered notes and half-formed ideas into an agent, which returned a talk outline with a narrative arc and first-draft slides for each section. (Agents: Claude · Source: dev.to)

item.title: Reorganize a chaotic cloud drive by project
item.description: A poster pointed an agent at a chaotic shared drive; it proposed a folder structure, moved files by project, and flagged duplicates for deletion. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Get a morning digest from team chat threads
item.description: A manager set an agent to read the team's Slack threads each evening and post a morning digest: what shipped, what's blocked, and who needs help. (Agents: n8n · Source: X)

item.title: Convert a Figma design into React components
item.description: A developer gave an agent a Figma file link and got back working React components with props, responsive behavior, and the design tokens extracted. (Agents: Claude Code · Source: Hacker News)

item.title: Audit dependencies for vulnerabilities and replacements
item.description: A poster had an agent audit their package.json, flag dependencies with known vulnerabilities, and suggest maintained replacements with migration notes. (Agents: Claude Code · Source: dev.to)

item.title: Generate API docs straight from source code
item.description: A backend developer pointed an agent at their API source code; it generated endpoint documentation with request/response examples that actually matched the code. (Agents: Claude · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Score inbound leads overnight against your ICP
item.description: A founder set an agent to score overnight form submissions against their ideal-customer profile, so mornings start with a ranked lead list instead of a raw inbox. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Indie Hackers)

item.title: Turn customer reviews into ad copy variations
item.description: A marketer fed an agent 200 customer reviews; it extracted the most repeated phrases and turned them into ad copy variations in the customers' own words. (Agents: ChatGPT · Source: X)

item.title: Draft an employee handbook from scattered policy docs
item.description: A small-company founder dumped scattered policy docs and Slack announcements into an agent, which drafted a structured employee handbook for legal review. (Agents: n8n · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Screen resumes against a scoring rubric
item.description: A hiring manager gave an agent a scoring rubric and 80 resumes; it returned a shortlist with scores and evidence quotes, cutting first-pass screening to minutes. (Agents: Claude · Source: Hacker News)

item.title: Practice job interviews with instant feedback
item.description: A job seeker ran mock interviews with an agent that asked role-specific questions, then gave feedback on answer structure and flagged weak spots to practice. (Agents: ChatGPT · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Get a plain-language brief of a research paper
item.description: A non-academic reader fed dense research papers to an agent, which returned plain-language briefs: what was studied, what was found, and why it matters. (Agents: Claude · Source: Substack)

item.title: Write a bedtime story series with consistent characters
item.description: A parent had an agent write a series of bedtime stories with the same two characters, keeping names, traits, and the world consistent across every episode. (Agents: ChatGPT · Source: X)

item.title: Brainstorm startup names and check domains
item.description: A founder gave an agent their product description; it brainstormed 50 names, checked domain availability for the shortlist, and ranked them by memorability. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Indie Hackers)

item.title: Track down a lost package across carriers
item.description: When a package showed as delivered but never arrived, a poster had an agent track it across carriers, draft the carrier inquiry, and escalate with the seller — the package was found at a neighbor's. (Agents: n8n · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Split your grocery list across the cheapest stores
item.description: A poster gave an agent their weekly grocery list; it compared prices across three nearby stores and split the list to minimize the total bill. (Agents: ChatGPT · Source: Threads)

item.title: Plan a kid's birthday party within a budget
item.description: A parent gave an agent a budget, headcount, and theme; it returned a full party plan with venue options, a shopping list, and a day-of timeline. (Agents: ChatGPT · Source: X)

item.title: Plan a multi-city trip within a budget
item.description: A traveler gave an agent a budget and dates; it compared routes and stays across cities and built a day-by-day itinerary. (Agents: ChatGPT · Source: X)

item.title: Chase unpaid invoices politely
item.description: A freelancer set an agent to send escalating payment reminders, log every response, and flag accounts that go quiet for human follow-up. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Track subscriptions and cancel the unused ones
item.description: An agent scanned email receipts for recurring charges, built a list with renewal dates, and drafted cancellation messages for the ones the poster never used. (Agents: n8n · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Monitor competitors' pricing pages for changes
item.description: An agent checks competitor pricing pages daily, diffs the content, and alerts the team only when something actually changed. (Agents: n8n · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Generate integration tests from a bug report
item.description: A developer had an agent reproduce a reported bug in a sandbox, then write regression tests covering the fix before the code change. (Agents: Claude Code · Source: X)

item.title: Negotiate a billing credit with an agent
item.description: A poster had an AI agent handle a billing dispute with their internet provider. The agent drafted replies, tracked the support thread, and kept the tone polite until a credit was offered. (Agents: n8n · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Onboard new hires with an agent buddy
item.description: A startup gave new hires an agent that answers policy questions, schedules intro meetings, and tracks onboarding checklists. (Agents: n8n · Source: X)

item.title: Review pull requests overnight
item.description: A small team set an agent to review incoming PRs after hours and leave comments by morning standup, with humans making final calls. (Agents: Claude Code · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Turn a messy inbox into a morning brief
item.description: An agent triages overnight email into a short brief: what needs a reply, what is FYI, and draft responses for the routine ones. (Agents: Claude · Source: X)

item.title: Draft outreach emails from a prospect list
item.description: An agent researched each company on a prospect list and wrote personalized opening lines, leaving the core pitch for the human to approve. (Agents: Claude · Source: X)

item.title: Learn a language through daily agent conversations
item.description: A poster practiced daily conversations with an agent that corrected mistakes and adjusted difficulty as they improved. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Plan a week of meals from what's in the fridge
item.description: From photos of the fridge and pantry, an agent generated a week of meal ideas plus a short grocery list for the gaps. (Agents: ChatGPT · Source: Substack)

item.title: Storyboard a short film from a one-line idea
item.description: A filmmaker gave an agent a one-line premise and got back scene breakdowns and a shot list to refine with a human crew. (Agents: Claude · Source: X)

item.title: Troubleshoot home appliances from a photo
item.description: A poster photographed a misbehaving appliance; the agent identified the model and walked through diagnostic steps before calling a technician. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Build a personal CRM from scattered contacts
item.description: A poster had an agent merge contacts from email signatures, calendar invites, and exports into one clean list with context on each person. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Move recurring team skills to an agent workforce
item.description: The poster transferred recurring responsibilities to agents using a mix of cloud and local-machine work, keeping humans on exceptions. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Generate podcast show notes and chapters
item.description: A podcaster has an agent transcribe each episode, then write summaries, chapter markers, and quote highlights for the show notes. (Agents: Claude · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Point a computer-using bot at any repo
item.description: A commenter says a computer-using agent can be told to work on any given repo through the browser, unlike repo-specific cloud agents. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Sell unused items online with an agent
item.description: The poster tested agent mode handling an online sale over about ten days, including message handling and price nudges, with little hands-on work. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Find unclaimed funds and start the claim
item.description: An agent searched state unclaimed-property databases for the poster's name, matched likely records, and pre-filled the claim paperwork for review. (Agents: ChatGPT · Source: X)

item.title: Turn documentation into practice quizzes
item.description: A team lead had an agent convert internal docs into quizzes so new engineers could test themselves during onboarding. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: X)

item.title: Find web design prospects with sales agents
item.description: The poster set up multiple agents that sell web services, including one that searches maps listings for businesses, checks for websites, and ranks them by priority. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Reddit)

item.title: Auto-file receipts for expense reports
item.description: An agent watches a dedicated inbox folder, extracts vendor, date, and total from each receipt, and files them for month-end reports. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: X)

item.title: Summarize a textbook chapter into flashcards
item.description: A student fed chapters to an agent that extracted key terms and definitions into flashcards for exam prep. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Substack)

item.title: Repurpose one webinar into a month of posts
item.description: A marketer had an agent cut a webinar recording into clips, write captions for each, and queue them across social channels. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Substack)

item.title: Compare insurance quotes line by line
item.description: An agent extracted coverage terms from several quote PDFs into a comparison table so the poster could see real differences, not just prices. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Substack)

item.title: Review last year's tax return for missed deductions
item.description: A poster fed prior-year return PDFs to an agent, which flagged deduction categories worth asking a CPA about. The poster stressed a human still files. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Substack)

item.title: Summarize every meeting into decisions and owners
item.description: An agent joins calls, then posts a recap with decisions made, owners assigned, and open questions nobody answered. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Substack)

item.title: Migrate a codebase to a new framework version
item.description: A poster ran agents module-by-module for a major version migration, with human review gates between each batch of changes. (Agents: Claude Code · Source: Substack)

item.title: Design a brand kit from three adjectives
item.description: A founder iterated with an agent on color palettes and type pairings starting from three brand adjectives, then handed the direction to a designer. (Agents: Custom agent · Source: Substack)
